card.name: Small linking words mid-clause before comparisons
card.fires_on: Small linking words (more, of, in, often, and, times) in the middle of a clause, right before the sentence names what is compared, changed, or counted. Most often seen after verbs like conform, decreases, initiating.

modes.label: Comparison words
modes.description: The word more or often inside a comparison of how frequently a group does something.
modes.example: as women would conform<< more>> often on masculine topics- ignorance on a

modes.label: Linking words in drug warnings
modes.description: The word and or times after initiating or at, just before dose changes.
modes.example: especially when initiating<< and>> following dosage increases with Oxymorphone

modes.label: Of or in before a quantity
modes.description: The word of or in after a noun like copy or decreases, before the thing measured.
modes.example: Reproduction studies in rats showed decreases<< in>> the number of pregnancies and in the number
